notes:
Arrange chip pins in the chip dialog; wires follow changed chips

Pins used to land wherever the board order put them. The chip dialog
now shows a preview of the package and lists per side in which the
pins are dragged into order or onto another side. Since that moves pins
of chips already in use, every board remembers where a chip's pins
were and lays the wires anew to their new places when it opens; a wire
on a pin that is gone or without a way is marked red.
